_comment: Merry & Bright Christmas Lights (merryandbrightchristmaslights.com) — Carnegie/Pittsburgh PA holiday lighting. Custom client infrastructure, planned 2026-08-22. 14 .info domains x 3 Sean Reynolds inboxes = 42, ALL GOOGLE (Tim's call 2026-08-22, the McFarlane pattern rather than the Landry's provider split). Domains are brand-derived, all confirmed available + non-premium on Spaceship 2026-08-22 and diffed against the 987 domains THT already owns. Modifiers chosen from the low-frequency tail of our existing fleet (go/hello/meet/today all <8 uses) so these do not cluster into a detectable network; pros/crew/group/team/service/outdoor deliberately avoided as they run 48-85 uses each. Domains: Spaceship. Inboxes: Zapmail. Run: python scripts/buy_batch_domains.py --batch batches/2026-08-22-merryandbright.json --execute, then acq_outlook.py --batch batches/2026-08-22-merryandbright.json --label 'Merry & Bright Google' --execute --no-buy once NS propagate.
